faq.question: How do I convert an image to Base64?
faq.answer: Upload your image and download the .txt output containing the data URI, ready to paste into HTML, CSS, JSON or Markdown.

faq.question: What exactly is inside the output file?
faq.answer: Exactly one RFC 2397 data URI (data:image/png;base64,...) of your ORIGINAL uploaded bytes - bit-exact, no re-encoding, nothing else.

faq.question: Why is the text file bigger than my image?
faq.answer: Base64 encoding adds about one third overhead (4 characters per 3 bytes); the underlying image data is unchanged.

faq.question: Is the conversion secure?
faq.answer: Yes, files are processed securely on our servers and automatically deleted after conversion.
